draft.title: Storage limitation: CRM, customer master data. Sample n=40 churned customers
draft.evidence: RetSched v2: delete 24 mo after contract end; 31/40 > 5 yrs old, full contact history still there; no automated purge, IT: manual cleanup 'planned'
draft.recommendation: System owner to configure automated deletion or anonymisation against the retention schedule and evidence the first run before the follow-up audit.
